repository.commit: No Git repository; source hashes in inventory.json

mathematics.assertion_tested: Lean kernel acceptance of the weighted lifting theorem for actual square polynomial systems over p-adic integers with a rationally invertible actual Jacobian and bounded inverse denominator, including root existence and uniqueness in the full p^(s+1) ball and displacement depth r-s when r>2s; inherited integer tower, perturbation and continuous chart theorems; expanded statement contracts and mathematically invalid controls
mathematics.coefficient_domain: New weighted theorem: finite square systems of multivariable polynomials over Z_p with arbitrary centers in Z_p^d and prime p; inherited chart interfaces retain their integer coefficient hypotheses
mathematics.conventions: Prime p; natural s,r with r>2s; J is the actual evaluated polynomial derivative; p^s J inverse has integral entries, equivalent to A J = J A = p^s I; uniqueness ball uses exponent s+1 and sharp displacement bound uses r-s
non_claims: Invariance under arbitrary polynomial presentation changes
Rank-nullity cardinality formulas over composite moduli
Analytic differentiability of the continuous parameter chart
Arbitrary p-adic coefficient extension of all rectangular chart interfaces
Uniqueness of roots for rectangular surjective Jacobians

residual_risks: Uses the pinned Lean kernel and precompiled Mathlib dependencies with the listed standard axioms.
